method: GNU time -v measures wall/user/system time and maximum RSS in KiB. Output identity uses sorted unique complete tagged physical lines joined by LF with no final LF, without path/text normalization. The immutable baseline binary predates this checkpoint; SDK inputs are on reconciled master d8202e706bd. Timing, file inventory and host activity are not controlled. Standalone shadowed-define comparisons include both the forward line cursor and lexer change. Final source gate is measured separately from the direct baseline scan and includes bootstrap/policy checks.

Host activity and Rayon/cache behavior vary, so do not extrapolate a universal suite speedup.
